title.zh: Webull 因被指与中国存在“结构性”关联的报道而暴跌 32%
title.en: Webull plunged 32% on report of ‘structural’ ties to China

current_state.zh: 美国众议院美中战略竞争特别委员会发布 23 页报告，称 Webull 存在与中国关联的数据安全风险，Webull 股价当日收跌 19% 至 5.89 美元；Webull 回应称报告存在重大不实，美国客户数据存储于美国境内，敏感数据访问权限由美国方面控制。
current_state.en: The US House Select Committee on the CCP released a 23-page report alleging China-linked data security risks at Webull, sending its shares down 19% to close at $5.89; Webull denied the report as materially false, saying US client data is stored domestically and sensitive access is controlled by US parties.

updates.title_zh: Webull 因被指与中国存在“结构性”关联的报道而暴跌 32%
updates.title_en: Webull plunged 32% on report of ‘structural’ ties to China
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国一个两党国会委员会报告将拥有2800万用户的券商Webull列为国家安全风险，指其所有权、人员、技术和合规在结构上与中国挂钩，Webull股价一度暴跌32%。
updates.what_changed_en: Webull shares plunged as much as 32% after a bipartisan US congressional committee report labeled the 28-million-user brokerage a national security risk, alleging its ownership, staffing, technology and compliance are structurally tied to China.

updates.current_state_en: Webull shares plunged as much as 32% after a bipartisan US congressional committee report labeled the 28-million-user brokerage a national security risk, alleging its ownership, staffing, technology and compliance are structurally tied to China.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Webull shares plunged as much as 32% after a bipartisan US congressional committee report labeled the 28-million-user brokerage a national security risk, alleging its ownership, staffing, technology and compliance are structurally tied to China.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Webull shares plunged as much as 32% after a bipartisan US congressional committee report labeled the 28-million-user brokerage a national security risk, alleging its ownership, staffing, technology and compliance are structurally tied to China.

updates.title_zh: 【美众议院委员会发布报告称 Webull 存在数据安全隐患，Webull 回应称报告存在重大不实】
updates.title_en: 【美众议院委员会发布报告称 Webull 存在数据安全隐患，Webull 回应称报告存在重大不实】
updates.what_changed_zh: Webull 发言人称该报告包含重大不实之处和缺乏依据的结论，并称美国客户数据存储于美国境内，敏感数据访问权限由美国方面控制；报告发布当日 Webull 股价收跌 19%，报 5.89 美元。
updates.what_changed_en: A Webull spokesperson called the report materially false and said US client data is stored domestically under US-controlled access; the stock closed down 19% at $5.89 on the day the report was released.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国众议院美中战略竞争特别委员会发布 23 页报告，称 Webull 存在与中国关联的数据安全风险，Webull 股价当日收跌 19% 至 5.89 美元；Webull 回应称报告存在重大不实，美国客户数据存储于美国境内，敏感数据访问权限由美国方面控制。
updates.current_state_en: The US House Select Committee on the CCP released a 23-page report alleging China-linked data security risks at Webull, sending its shares down 19% to close at $5.89; Webull denied the report as materially false, saying US client data is stored domestically and sensitive access is controlled by US parties.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The US House Select Committee on the CCP released a 23-page report alleging China-linked data security risks at crypto-trading broker Webull, sending its shares down 19%, while Webull called the report materially false and said US client data is stored domestically under US-controlled access.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The US House Select Committee on the CCP released a 23-page report alleging China-linked data security risks at crypto-trading broker Webull, sending its shares down 19%, while Webull called the report materially false and said US client data is stored domestically under US-controlled access.
